Class AbstractFileRepository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object

repository.AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>

ID - the identifier type

All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
FriendShipFileRepository, UserFileRepository
public abstract class AbstractFileRepository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>> extends InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Abstract generic repository that synchronizes in-memory storage with a text file.
